import { Controller, Inject, Injectable, Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  ClientProxy,
  ClientsModule,
  MessagePattern,
  Transport,
} from '@nestjs/microservices';

const NEGATIVE_CLIENT = 'NEGATIVE_CLIENT';

@Injectable()
class DynamicPatternPublisher {
  constructor(@Inject(NEGATIVE_CLIENT) private readonly client: ClientProxy) {}

  // D0_CASE:microservices-pattern-spread-dynamic
  dynamicSpread(pattern: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    this.client.emit({ ...pattern }, {});
  }

  // D0_CASE:microservices-pattern-nonserializable
  nonserializable(): void {
    this.client.send({ cmd: () => 'not-json' }, {});
  }
}

@Injectable()
class InvalidProviderHandler {
  // D0_CASE:microservices-handler-provider-invalid
  @MessagePattern('invalid.provider')
  handle(): void {}
}

class LocalClientProxy {
  send(_pattern: unknown, _data: unknown): void {}
}

@Injectable()
class LookalikePublisher {
  constructor(private readonly client: LocalClientProxy) {}

  // D0_CASE:microservices-client-lookalike
  publish(): void {
    this.client.send('lookalike.pattern', {});
  }
}

namespace LocalDecorators {
  export function MessagePattern(_pattern: unknown): MethodDecorator {
    return () => undefined;
  }
}

@Controller()
class LookalikeHandler {
  // D0_CASE:microservices-handler-lookalike
  @LocalDecorators.MessagePattern('lookalike.pattern')
  handle(): void {}
}

@Module({
  imports: [ClientsModule.register([{ name: NEGATIVE_CLIENT, transport: Transport.RMQ }])],
  controllers: [LookalikeHandler],
  providers: [DynamicPatternPublisher, InvalidProviderHandler, LookalikePublisher, LocalClientProxy],
})
class NegativeMicroserviceModule {}

const __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__ = (() => {
  throw new Error('D0 Nest microservices fixture must never execute: negatives');
})();
void __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__;
